result.summary: The pedestrian environment is significantly degraded, with the primary walkway on the left consisting of broken pavement and dirt, creating tripping hazards and accessibility barriers. There are no marked crossings or traffic calming measures visible, and the presence of blank building walls reduces the sense of security for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Severely degraded sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left is broken, unpaved in sections, and covered in debris, making it impassable for those with mobility aids and a trip hazard for others.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground and mid-ground along the building frontage

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible crosswalks, forcing pedestrians to cross the two-lane road without designated space or priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible street segment

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and repave the sidewalk to provide a continuous, level, and ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The street features a residential environment with a sidewalk on only one side, leaving the other side completely inaccessible to pedestrians due to fencing and parked vehicles. The lack of marked crossings and the presence of large parked vehicles creating sightline obstructions significantly compromise pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The right side of the street lacks a paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the travel lane or on unpaved surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway adjacent to the brick building

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white van parked on the street obscures the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic, especially near the alleyway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, parked in front of the brick building

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the alleyway or potential crossing points to improve pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the alleyway to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by a large area of mud and standing water on the right-hand walkway, which effectively creates a gap in the sidewalk network. While the left side has a functional sidewalk, the overall infrastructure lacks modern safety features like high-visibility crosswalks or curb extensions, and the degraded pavement on the right forces pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk flooding and mud
hazards.description: A large puddle and mud pit completely block the walkway on the right side, forcing pedestrians into the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground and midground

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicle
hazards.description: A large white van parked near the intersection on the left limits sightlines between pedestrians and approaching traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: The roadway edge and walkway area on the right are severely eroded and unpaved.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction and Drainage
interventions.description: Pave the missing sidewalk section on the right and install proper drainage to prevent standing water and mud accumulation.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings at the intersection to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the corner, improving visibility.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow residential alley or minor street that lacks dedicated pedestrian sidewalks, forcing pedestrians to share the roadway with vehicles. The environment is characterized by a large blank wall and vacant lot on one side and row houses built directly to the edge of the pavement on the other.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no dedicated sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk in the narrow travel lane used by vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway extending into the background

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: A large blank wall on the left side of the street reduces natural surveillance and creates a hostile pedestrian environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, large grey wall

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No visible street lighting infrastructure, which significantly increases risk for pedestrians at night.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible street corridor

interventions.title: Shared Street (Woonerf) Treatment
interventions.description: Implement a shared street design with textured paving and signage to clearly indicate pedestrian priority in the absence of sidewalks.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install wall-mounted or pole-mounted lighting to improve visibility and personal security along the narrow corridor.

interventions.title: Active Frontage Improvements
interventions.description: Encourage murals or landscaping along the blank wall to improve the visual environment and perceived safety.
